questionnaires.title: General Problem Identification Survey
questionnaires.description: Help us understand common challenges people face

questions.question: What area of your life would you like to improve most?
On a scale of 1-10, how satisfied are you with this area?
What specific challenges do you face in this area?
How often do these challenges affect your daily life?

settings.completion_reward: Thank you for helping us understand community needs!

questionnaires.title: I'll pay to..
questionnaires.description: Tell us what problems you'd pay to have solved — your answers help us build solutions that matter.

questions.question: Email
questions.help_text: Used only to follow up about solutions to the problem you describe. Not sold or shared.

questions.question: What problem(s) would you pay to have solved?
Have you tried any existing solutions?
If yes, what were the existing solutions lacking?
questions.placeholder: Describe what was missing or frustrating...

questions.question: What payment model do you prefer?
How much one-time fee are you willing to pay for the solution?
How much subscription fee are you willing to pay for the solution?
How urgent is this problem for you?
options: Not urgent at all - I can live with this problem indefinitely
Slightly urgent - It would be nice to solve eventually, but no rush
Moderately urgent - I'd like to solve this within the next few months
Very urgent - I need a solution within the next few weeks
Extremely urgent - I need this solved as soon as possible, it's affecting my daily life/work

settings.completion_reward: Thank you for sharing what you'd pay to solve — we'll be in touch if we build something for your problem.
